title: Wonderful tour!!
text: We loved this tour!! Seville is full of both beautiful sights around every corner, and also a very rich and interesting history. This guide allows you to take in many highlights at your own pace. We knew we would enjoy this tour since the same person produced one we also loved in Granada (Albaicin and Sacromonte). 2 hours was the right amount of time for a leisurely walk.
author: joegW4454ZY

title: Great way to learn about Seville’s history
text: Really enjoyable! Lots of interesting info about Seville's history and took us on a nice route past some sights we hadn’t visited before. The app works great.
author: andaluzt2024
